subject: Re: Air freight quote request: FRA to KUL
body:
Thank you for your offer. That seems too low to be right, so we will not go ahead with it.

Mit freundlichen Gruessen / Kind regards
Jonas Kessler
Logistics Coordinator
Kessler Feinmechanik GmbH, Ulm

classification.reasoning: The customer declines the quote, saying the price seems too low and they will not proceed.
